notifications.title: The auditor ran before the day's data audit, two nights running
notifications.detail: Tonight's auditor routine started at 19:26 IST (13:56 UTC), not its 23:00 IST slot, and the Data audit workflow hadn't run yet (its runs start 14:56-18:55 UTC: 7 Nov 14:56, 8 Nov 15:23, 9 Nov 18:55). Last night the audit was also late. So the dashboard-vs-YouTube check was skipped both nights. The last audit (9 Nov) had 0 errors and 0 warnings across 49 checked videos.
notifications.fix: 1. In claude.ai → Code → Routines, check the auditor routine is set to 23:00 IST (17:30 UTC). 2. Optional: in GitHub → Actions → Data audit, confirm a 10 Nov run appears this evening. Nothing else is needed.

notifications.title: The hourly watchdog runs only every 4-11 hours
notifications.detail: watchdog.yml is scheduled every hour, but GitHub ran it 11 times between 7 Nov 09:58 and 10 Nov 09:42 UTC (gaps of 4-11 hours). The hourly view snapshots behind the dashboard's 'realtime' chart and the variant system's 48-hour views therefore have gaps (the 48-hour count interpolates across them), and owner alerts can arrive hours late.
notifications.fix: Optional. 1. Accept it, or 2. trigger watchdog.yml from an outside scheduler (e.g. cron-job.org calling the workflow_dispatch API with a fine-grained token limited to Actions on this repo). Workflows are owner-only files.
